notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped interaction retraction fan-out surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies delivered-copy Request Retraction callbacks, suppression of still-queued fan-out copies, independent recipient delivery, and post-resignation immediate delivery without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped SendInteraction and Retract with FederateAmbassador timestamped receive and retraction callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped retraction and FederateAmbassador callback declarations
